channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Budenholzer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Budenholzer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Antetokounmpo:

“I'm telling you the truth. I see, of course; I interview, but I don't make the decision. That's everyone, not just me. All the players, well not all of them - for the longest time it was Bud [coach Mike Budenholzer], Giannis and Khris [Middleton]. But I don't make a decision. I was the youngest player on the team.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Mike Budenholzer, Apr 7, 2026. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy
item.description:
RC Buford:

“I think we had many coaches over the last 10 years who could have stepped into that role. Ime Udoka was with us, along with James Borrego, Brett Brown, Mike Budenholzer, and Will Hardy. There were many people with us who could have stepped into that role, but the longer Coach Pop stayed, the more those coaches moved on to other opportunities. When we needed Mitch to step up, he did so in a big way. It was incredibly emotional for him to take on that role. ‘Interim’ is probably the wrong word, because at the time of Pop’s stroke, we didn’t know whether Pop could come back. Mitch had that year to show the players—and all of us—who he could be as a coach.”

RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy, Mar 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mat Ishbia on Mike Budenholzer and the Suns' next head coach:

“We've gotta get the next hire right, and we will.... There's a lot of reasons why coach Bud is not here,I'm not gonna get into all of those, but we definitely should've won more games”

Mat Ishbia on Mike Budenholzer, Apr 17, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Ryan Dunn on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Suns rookie Ryan Dunn on Mike Budenholzer:

“Old-school coach or hard-nosed coach that likes to get after it on people, no matter who you are. He kind of has his ways that he agrees with and he believes in. He wants the best for everybody.”

Ryan Dunn on Mike Budenholzer, Apr 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Kevin Durant on if he wished Mike Budenholzer kept in the game to start the 2nd quarter after scoring 16 points in the 1st quarter of Suns 30-point loss to Boston:

“I prefer to play 48 minutes every night, but I know how realistic that is. I feel like I'm always simmering hot regardless. I might be 0-for-10 and you've seen games this year I start 1-of-9 and I end up finishing the game shooting well because I feel like I'm always hot. Maybe that's a little overconfidence in myself or delusion, but that's how I feel when I'm out there.”

Kevin Durant on Mike Budenholzer, Mar 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“To say I was frustrated about that — that’s just a basketball thing that we always (feel). We trying to figure it out, you know what I mean? Style of play is not something that I’m pissed off at the team about. It’s just like, ‘Yo, we need to figure it out to get better.’ I think [new head coach Mike Budenholzer] has been watching film of what we did last year to try to incorporate some of those things that worked for us and try to finetune some of the things that didn’t.”

Kevin Durant on Mike Budenholzer, Jul 10, 2024. Source: Arizona's Sports Page.

item.title: Serge Ibaka on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Ibaka, 33, said he signed with Milwaukee knowing he wasn’t going to play as much as he wanted to and that he had talked about the situation with former coach Mike Budenholzer before signing.

“(Budenholzer) told me to my face: Listen, you’re coming here, I promise you nothing — but you never know, it’s a long season, guys can have injuries, you have to stay ready,”

Serge Ibaka on Mike Budenholzer, Aug 3, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Budenholzer:

“My first response is not shock but disappointment ... this is the business we're in. Expectations for every team are so high, and only one team can win. We all believe Bud deserved better, but we're all aware this is the job we chose.”

Steve Kerr on Mike Budenholzer, May 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @johnhollinger.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Mike Budenholzer, Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Darvin Ham on the coaching matchup with Taylor Jenkins, who Ham coached alongside for years under Mike Budenholzer in Atlanta and Milwaukee:

“We’ll get to see who was right in all of those coaches meetings when we would argue.”

Darvin Ham on Mike Budenholzer, Taylor Jenkins, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Bucks’ Giannis Antetokounmpo on whether it’s time to extend his minutes down 0-2 to Heat:

“I’m going to do whatever coach (Mike Budenholzer) tells me to do. That’s what I’ve been doing all year. Obviously I’d love to play 48 minutes, but he sees the game, he coaches the game.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Mike Budenholzer, Sep 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
“(Bucks coach) Mike (Budenholzer) does a great job of calling plays on the fly, plays that have worked all series,”

Kyrie Irving on Mike Budenholzer, May 7, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Howard recently told The Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

“Coach (Mike Budenholzer) has total confidence in me shooting the basketball. So, that’s not an issue. I think in the past I’ve started to shoot and then I’ve stopped. I can’t allow missing or anything like that to affect how I play on the floor.”

Dwight Howard on Mike Budenholzer, Oct 3, 2016. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Mike Budenholzer, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Schroder said of Budenholzer.

“But then he apologized. He couldn’t see [the Thomas incident].“I talked back [to Thomas] and [Budenholzer] didn’t see the situation that happened before,”

Dennis Schroder on Mike Budenholzer, Isaiah Thomas, Apr 23, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Danny Ferry on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
“We are on a good path right now. We are very well-coached; when healthy we were a very good team that played with a substance and a clear system-based identity that I really like. “Being the eighth seed in a playoffs is not ever going to be our goal. We want more than that as a team. Our group will keep focusing on finding ways to get better every day. Again, (coach Mike Budenholzer), our players, (co-owner) Bruce (Levenson), we are all going to do good things going forward.”

Danny Ferry on Mike Budenholzer, Mar 31, 2014. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Zaza Pachulia on Danny Ferry, Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
“There is no question about it. The franchise has been great to me over the past eight years from the owners to the front office, coaches and of course the fans. “But I also understand the situation because the [front office] has so many things to do this summer. Danny Ferry has so much work to do. Obviously being somewhat of a new general manager here and hiring a new head coach (Mike Budenholzer). Now they have to fill out the team with players. There are so many roster spots available, so I understand the business side of it.”

Zaza Pachulia on Danny Ferry, Mike Budenholzer, Jul 1, 2013. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Tony Parker on Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:From Tony Parker:

“Mike Budenholzer has been extremely important to our success in San Antonio. He is a great coach.”

Tony Parker on Mike Budenholzer, May 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @ajchawks.
